title: Sharp parameter gaps for quantized Mabuchi energies and cscK metrics
summary: For polarized manifolds, we show that semistability for the quantized Mabuchi energy at one fixed finite parameter is equivalent to uniform K-stability and to unique existence of constant scalar curvature Kähler (cscK) metrics. We obtain sharp comparisons between quantized Mabuchi slopes at different parameters and with the ordinary Mabuchi slope. In the presence of automorphisms, we give an equivariant criterion using torus twists under the vanishing of the Futaki character.
